# Crew API reference

**Local pages, not a mirror.** This directory is Kiro Crew's own documentation and has no upstream source. It is a named exception in [the Reference index](../README.md).

The Crew API is the HTTP API of a Kiro Crew gateway, under `/v1`. Each endpoint below is marked **Available now**, when the gateway serves it, or **Planned**. An available endpoint also says which callers the gateway serves it to: the owner only, or the owner and apps.

- **Tier** says who an endpoint is for: Public endpoints are for apps, Owner endpoints for the owner of this Kiro Crew alone.
- **Stability** says how far the request and response shapes are settled: `stable` shapes only gain fields, `preview` and `experimental` shapes may still change.
- Every refusal has one body, [Error](schemas.md#error). The objects the endpoints send and receive are in [schemas.md](schemas.md).

## Owner endpoints

Endpoints only the owner of this Kiro Crew may call. Every path starts with `/v1/crew/owner/`.

| Endpoint | What it does | Status | Stability |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`GET /v1/crew/owner/bots`](owner-bots.md#get-v1crewownerbots) | Bot roster (the full list, Owner view) | Available now: owner only | experimental |
| [`GET /v1/crew/owner/grants`](owner-grants.md#get-v1crewownergrants) | List grants (with usage) | Available now: owner only | stable |
| [`PATCH /v1/crew/owner/grants/{grant_id}`](owner-grants.md#patch-v1crewownergrantsgrant_id) | Tighten a grant: lower quota, remove Bots, change sensitivity and notification limit | Planned | stable |
| [`DELETE /v1/crew/owner/grants/{grant_id}`](owner-grants.md#delete-v1crewownergrantsgrant_id) | Revoke a grant | Available now: owner only | stable |
| [`POST /v1/crew/owner/grants/{grant_id}/resume`](owner-grants.md#post-v1crewownergrantsgrant_idresume) | Resume a paused or throttled grant | Planned | stable |
| [`GET /v1/crew/owner/grants/{grant_id}/decisions`](owner-grants.md#get-v1crewownergrantsgrant_iddecisions) | Read the monitor's decision log | Planned | stable |
| [`GET /v1/crew/owner/grant-requests`](owner-consent.md#get-v1crewownergrant-requests) | List grant requests waiting for consent | Available now: owner only | stable |
| [`GET /v1/crew/owner/grant-requests/{request_id}`](owner-consent.md#get-v1crewownergrant-requestsrequest_id) | Read one grant request | Available now: owner only | stable |
| [`POST /v1/crew/owner/grant-requests/{request_id}/decision`](owner-consent.md#post-v1crewownergrant-requestsrequest_iddecision) | Approve or deny a grant request | Available now: owner only | stable |
| [`GET /v1/crew/owner/approvals`](owner-approvals.md#get-v1crewownerapprovals) | List tool approvals | Available now: owner only | stable |
| [`GET /v1/crew/owner/approvals/{approval_id}`](owner-approvals.md#get-v1crewownerapprovalsapproval_id) | Read one tool approval | Available now: owner only | stable |

| [`GET /v1/crew/owner/connectors`](owner-connectors.md#get-v1crewownerconnectors) | List consented connectors | Planned | stable |
| [`GET /v1/crew/owner/connectors/{client_id}`](owner-connectors.md#get-v1crewownerconnectorsclient_id) | Read a connector's manifest and hash | Planned | stable |
